name: Pcsx2
description: PCSX2 is an open source PS2 Emulator.

questions.label: Web port
questions.hint: The port on this server that opens the app.

compose:
services:
  app:
    image: linuxserver/pcsx2:2.8.2@sha256:fe2bb6d7bbec92eb0c4ed0bda816d07f5ed8ce184127c0584338a2778038eb62
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      PUID: $PUID
      PGID: $PGID
      TZ: $TZ
    ports:
      - target: 3000
        published: "${APP_PORT}"
        protocol: tcp
      - target: 3001
        published: 3001
        protocol: tcp
    volumes:
      - type: bind
        source: ${APP_DATA_DIR}/config
        target: /config
